videos.caption: Apparently, we’ve reached the point where the President of the United States is posting AI videos of himself wrestling a tiger. 🐅🇺🇸 And while we’re all supposed to find this hilarious, can we acknowledge that a real person actually lost their life in a tiger enclosure that he is emulating? I’m sure their grieving family is just THRILLED to see something so tragic turned into presidential entertainment. 🙄 But since Trump apparently fancies himself the Tiger Whisperer, I have a suggestion. Forget the AI. Let’s see those legendary animal-charming skills in real life. No Photoshop. No CGI. Just a tiger, a very secure enclosure, and a whole lot of confidence. And if he needs a little encouragement, somebody just whisper: “Sir, Biden already did it.” He’ll be demanding a tiger enclosure at Mar-a-Lago before dinner. 😂🐅 Seriously, though. There’s a difference between having a sense of humor and making light of somebody else’s death. And apparently, artificial intelligence can generate a tiger, but it still can’t generate empathy.
